infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Operator Absinthe, one of the Ursus civilians rescued in the Chernobog incident, voluntarily applied to join Rhodes Island. 
After receiving a series of tests and undergoing training, she was approved to join an operational squad as a Caster Operator, while also providing services within the ship such as patrolling.
text.zh:
干员苦艾，切尔诺伯格事件中被救助的乌萨斯平民之一，自愿申请加入罗德岛。
在接受了一系列测试与培训后，被批准作为术师干员加入作战小队，同时也提供舰内巡逻等相关服务。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Absinthe has no signs of Originium infections. 
Being able to keep herself safe in situations like those means that her abilities must be solid enough, in addition to having the devil's luck. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Operator Absinthe had been exposed to an Originium-dense region for weeks prior to boarding, and extra attention must paid to potential virulence.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员苦艾没有被源石感染的迹象。
在那样的情况下能够保全自身安全，这说明她的确能力不弱，并且运气不差。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.14u/L
干员苦艾在登舰前的数周之内，一直身处十分危险的源石环境中，需时刻关注其是否出现感染倾向。

text.en:
A survivor of the Chernobog-Lungmen incident and daughter of a local policeman, Absinthe, following her onboarding, described in detail Chernobog's gradual descent into chaos under Reunion's occupation. According to her account, Reunion's attack came very suddenly. The local police force, as the basic unit of security in the city, could barely maintain order and evacuate the crowds even at the beginning. But as the situation worsened and the Catastrophe arrived, the line of defense was torn down, with violence and panic engulfing the entire city like a wildfire. 
The Ursursians who remained struggled amidst the despair to cling to their lives, working together with a small team of local police officers after the Catastrophe. In a short period of time, this group went from initially trying to maintain order and protect civilians, to a state of being unable to fend for themselves, even stealing food to survive. When Rhodes Island's rescue team found Absinthe, she was laying on her back amidst a heap of rubble, alone and dying from hunger. If the rescue team showed up any later, there is no saying what would have happened to her. Perhaps not even her body would have been left in place. 

Through the entire crisis, the survivors trapped in the city waited for the arrival of those tasked with protecting them, but help never arrived.
text.zh:
作为切尔诺伯格-龙门事件的幸存者，以及本地警察的女儿，在登上舰船后，苦艾向我们描述了在整合运动的占领下，切尔诺伯格逐步陷入混乱的过程。据她讲述，整合运动的袭击来得十分突然，作为城市内的基础安全保障系统，当地警力在最开始时，还能勉强维持秩序，疏散人群。但随着局势的发酵以及天灾的到来，这层防线最终被冲垮，暴力与恐慌开始在整座城中大规模蔓延。
置身此地的乌萨斯人无一不在绝望之中挣扎求生，苦艾本人在天灾后与一小队当地警察共同行动，在这段时间里，他们从最初的试图维持秩序、保护平民，到之后的无力自保，甚至要抢夺食物才能勉强生存，这个过程并没有耗费多少时间。当罗德岛的救援队伍找到苦艾时，她仰面躺在废墟中，只有她一个人，因饥饿而奄奄一息。如果救援再来迟一些，谁也不敢猜测这个女孩会有怎样的结局，或许连尸体都不会被留在原地。

被困在这座城市的幸存者们，从始至终，都没有等到本该保护他们的军队到来。

text.en:
During the time she was training and taking exams, Absinthe's performance satisfied all of Instructor Dobermann's standards. She may not have been gifted with great athleticism or combat acumen, but her tenacity coupled with the basic training she had received helped her quickly grow into a qualified operator. However, her lackadaisical attitude towards getting injured during training and exceedingly cavalier lifestyle habits are causes for concern. 
The medical department's assessment shows that Absinthe's mental health markers are troubling; she views many issues with significant pessimism, and also displays degrees of self-loathing and self-destructive tendencies. This Ursus girl rarely seeks to establish personal agency in her daily life, instead subconsciously trying to help others around her. However, at the same time, she belittles her own actions to the point of even negating whatever results she may have achieved, a behavior that, in the eyes of the medic operators, is very concerning. 
Another important issue to bring up is the strong concerns raised by the Ursus Student Self-government Group. Before joining Rhodes Island, Absinthe knew nothing about the members of the Self-Governing Group, and vice versa. It is unclear why Absinthe now pays so much attention to their activities, and she is unwilling to talk about the matter. These anomalous behaviors may have something to do with her past experiences in Peterheim Middle School. We can surmise that there must be some undiscovered facts regarding the time she spent there. 
Under the premise that this status will not cause damage to Rhodes Island, related background investigations have been temporarily suspended out of respect for Operator Absinthe.
text.zh:
在接受训练与测试期间，苦艾在各方面的表现都令作为教官的杜宾感到满意。她或许并不是天生身体素质与战斗意识都绝佳的那一类战士，但苦艾本身坚韧执着的性格，以及其曾经接受过的一些基础训练，都帮助她快速成长为一名合格的干员。但是这种在训练时就算受伤也从不叫苦，日常生活中对自身过于随意、不关心的态度，多少也令人对其状态感到担忧。
医疗部门的评测显示，苦艾的精神状态并不乐观，她在许多问题上表现得十分消极，并且展示出了一定程度的自我苛责与自毁倾向。这个乌萨斯女孩在日常中很少有明确的自我主张，她会下意识地保护身边的人，但同时又会贬低自己的行为，甚至会将自己取得的成果全盘否定，在医疗人员看来，这种表现无疑是非常糟糕的。
另一个值得在意的问题点是，苦艾对于乌萨斯学生自治团成员表现出了强烈的关注。在登上罗德岛之前，她与自治团成员互不相识，为何如此关注学生自治团的原因不明，苦艾本人也对此闭口不谈。种种反常表现或许与其过去经历有关，围绕彼得海姆中学，我们可以确定一定还有一些未曾被发掘的事实。
在判断其状态并不会为罗德岛带来损害的前提下，出于对干员苦艾本人的尊重，相关背景调查暂时被叫停。

text.en:
The attack on Chernobog was a key component of Reunion's plans. They plotted in secret, completely catching the city off guard when they struck. Before Chernobog's residents realized what was going on, much of the city had already been occupied. 
We can reconstruct an account of what happened in the incident's aftermath based upon oral narratives from survivors. Reunion's leaders partitioned the city and controlled different zones, with certain zones being controlled more strictly than others. In certain places, people could remain unharmed as long as they stayed behind closed doors. But many citizens in other areas were not so lucky... You already know what I mean by that. Certain Reunion leaders encouraged the Infected to 'claim their legitimate rights,' which is a euphemism for allowing gratuitous violence. When an excessively emotional catharsis morphs into hivemind behavior, one can imagine the kind of disaster that would ensue.
Police? Compared to the sheer number of Infected who had given in to fanaticism, the amount of peace officers and military police simply was too small. While they were better equipped and trained than the average Reunion rioter, that alone was not sufficient, and the following Catastrophe tore through what little defenses were left in the city. The Chernobog police continued to send backup requests to the garrison during this time, but judging from the results, such attempts were futile. 

How did that girl stay alive in those conditions until the time she was rescued? What kind of things did she have to go through? 
I won't ask her to answer those questions. I can see that she's doing well enough with us, and despite her doubts and anxieties, she's making an effort to understand what happened in the past and shake off the lingering effects of those events. I even saw her trying to make friends, to try to be more inviting and to not push others away. This is no easy feat, and it is also a good sign. There's no way we could heartlessly pry open those wounds. We all need to be more cautious and circumspect when dealing with people who have suffered through disasters. If she is willing to open up, then we shall listen. As for right now, she has already done enough. 

—Transcript of conversation with Archives Department's logistics operator
text.zh:
袭击切尔诺伯格是整合运动计划好的关键一步，他们在暗中谋划许久，打了这座城市一个措手不及，很多街区直到被占领，里面的人都还没有回过神。
我们可以从事后幸存者的口述中还原当时的情况，整合运动的干部分管不同的区域，一些地区受到严格管控，人们只要闭门不出，就可以免遭侵害。但另一些区域的市民，就没有那么幸运……你知道我在说什么，有一些整合运动的干部放纵甚至鼓励感染者们去“争取正当的权益”，说白了，在那时候，暴力是被允许的，当过激的情绪宣泄演变成集体行为，可以想象那是怎样一场灾难。
警察？和陷入狂热情绪的感染者比起来，警察和军警的人数还是太少了，他们的确比大多数整合暴徒都更加装备精良，更加训练有素，但仅仅是这样仍然不够，随后而来的天灾更是将城市内的防线撕得四分五裂。切尔诺伯格的警方在此期间一直持续向驻军发送讯号寻求支援，但从结果来看，这种努力是徒劳的。

那个女孩是怎么在这样的状况下活着等到救援的？她都经历了什么？
我不会去问她这种问题，我能看出她在我们这里过得不错，我看到她有疑问，有动摇，但至少有在努力尝试理解过去发生的事，努力去摆脱那些事情对她自己的影响。我甚至看到她在试着去交朋友，她开始没有那么排斥他人的接近了，这是好事，这很不容易。我们不能冷酷地去质问。对待这些蒙受灾难的人，我们都需要更加谨慎，更加小心。如果她愿意说，那就听。至少现在，这样就足够了。

——与档案部后勤干员的交谈记录

text.en:
The vast majority of rescued Chernobog refugees will, after a short resting period, stay with relatives or friends, or to go elsewhere to live alone. After that, Rhodes Island operators will escort them to their chosen destinations so that they may start a new life. At the same time, some of the refugees will end up staying with Rhodes Island for a variety of reasons. 
Absinthe's parents were confirmed to have passed away during the Chernobog incident. When the logistics operator confirmed other kinship ties with Absinthe, the latter rejected the offer to be sent to another city and voluntarily applied to join Rhodes Island. Without a doubt, what she had experienced during the last month had driven her to make this decision. 
The devastation wrought by Reunion's occupation, the destruction caused by the Catastrophe, and the ugly face of today's complex conflicts - all of these may have well played a role. As the turmoil continued, a shortage of food and drinking water turned these conflicts into something much simpler and more primal. Whether Infected or not, status mattered little when the only thing that remained was a cruel struggle for basic necessities. 

The Medical Department has been closely monitoring the mental health of all survivors of the Chernobog-Lungmen incident. Unlike the members of the Ursus Student Self-government Group who also escaped from Chernobog, Absinthe's depression and pain takes on a much more direct manner. She rarely shows a real smile, and very few people are able to approach her. More often then not, Absinthe chooses to stay far away from others and maintain a subdued silence. Nevertheless, Absinthe has already helped many people; she may be taciturn, but she is undoubtedly reliable. Perhaps Absinthe views her own actions as trivial and insignificant, but we believe that kindness begets kindness and eagerly look forward to Absinthe's future development. 
Just like the hair that she cut herself, perhaps only time can heal her scars.
text.zh:
绝大多数被救助的切尔诺伯格市民，会在短时间的停留之后选择投奔亲朋，或独自去别处谋生，届时他们将由罗德岛的各位干员分批护送前往各自选定的城市，在那里展开新的生活。与此同时，也会有一些被救助者出于种种不同的缘由，最终留在罗德岛。
干员苦艾的双亲已经确认于切尔诺伯格的动荡中离世，在后勤干员向其确认其他亲属关系时，苦艾拒绝了前往其他城市的建议，主动申请加入罗德岛。而驱使她做出这样选择的，毫无疑问是她在过去一个月中的那些见闻。
不仅仅是整合运动的侵占与破坏，天灾直接摧毁了建筑、街道，同时也摧毁了明面上的种种对立关系。在动乱后期，食品与饮用水的短缺使得对立转化为更加直白原始的模式，不分感染与否，不论敌方还是己方，那里仅剩的就是围绕生存资源展开的残酷争斗。

医疗部一直密切关注所有切尔诺伯格-龙门事件幸存者的精神状态，与同样自切尔诺伯格逃生的乌萨斯学生自治团成员不同，干员苦艾的忧郁与痛苦展现得更加直接，她很少真正展露笑容，很少有人能够让她放下戒备主动亲近，更多时候，干员苦艾选择保持带着压抑的沉默，远离他人。尽管如此，干员苦艾也已经帮助了许多人，她沉默寡言，但却坚实可靠。也许在苦艾本人看来，她所做的都是些不足一提的小事，但善意唤来善意，对于干员苦艾今后的发展，我们始终怀抱一份期望。
就同被她自己亲手割断的头发一样，或许只有时间，才能治愈这片伤痕。

text.en:
Even though her words were filled with confusion, as if everything she knew to be true was faltering, she never let go of the equipment she inherited from her father.
That pure idealism, a belief in the beauty of justice and protecting those in need, has never truly been sullied, even despite being dragged through veritable hell.
text.zh:
尽管言语中充斥茫然，曾经所相信的都摇摇欲坠，但继承自父亲的装备，她却从来没有真正松开手。
那个单纯美好，关于正义与保护的信念，就算亲眼见过最糟的现实，她也从来没有真正放下过。
